fullName.value: TPR repeat-containing big gene cloned at Keio

texts.value: During mitosis, may be involved in the condensation of spindle midzone microtubules, leading to the formation of midbody

At interphase, localizes to centrosomes. At prometaphase and metaphase, associated with spindle microtubules and spindle poles. At anaphase, accumulates in the spindle midzone. At telophase, condensed on central spindles. During cytokinesis, condensed on the midbody where it colocalizes with AURKB (By similarity)

location.value: Cytoplasm, cytoskeleton, microtubule organizing center, centrosome

texts.value: Widely expressed in fetal tissues. In adult tissues, expressed in testis and ovary and, at much lower levels, in kidney and pancreas
